text_block_list.text:
Despite being the daughter of a
legendary
Umamusume, Кинг Хало ends
up disappointing
her fans at the
Накаяма Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But this doesn't deter her. She vows to
take first
place in her next race, the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That night, Кинг Хало returns to the
academy to
see Спешл Уик, who
professes her desire to win
the Japanese
Derby for her mothers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, Кинг Хало becomes further
fueled to
gain success, and she decides
to put in extra
practice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
